parameters.name: BW4MHz
parameters.description: Indicates support for 4 MHz operation.

parameters.name: BW8MHz
parameters.description: Indicates support for 8 MHz operation.

parameters.name: BW16MHz
parameters.description: Indicates support for 16 MHz operation.

parameters.name: S1GLong
parameters.description: Indicates support for the reception of S1G_LONG Physical layer Protocol Data Units (PPDUs).

parameters.name: BW1MHzShortGI
parameters.description: Indicates support for 1 MHz short Guard Interval (GI).

parameters.name: BW2MHzShortGI
parameters.description: Indicates support for 2 MHz short GI.

parameters.name: BW4MHzShortGI
parameters.description: Indicates support for 4 MHz short GI.

parameters.name: BW8MHzShortGI
parameters.description: Indicates support for 8 MHz short GI.

parameters.name: BW16MHzShortGI
parameters.description: Indicates support for 16 MHz short GI.

parameters.name: AMSDU
parameters.description: Indicates support of Aggregated MAC Service Data Units (AMSDU).

parameters.name: AMPDU
parameters.description: Indicates support of Aggregated MAC Protocol Data Units (AMPDU).

parameters.name: FlowControl
parameters.description: Indicates support for Flow Control {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 10.61}}.

parameters.name: CentralizedAuthenticationControl
parameters.description: Indicates support for Centralized Authentication Control {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 11.3.9.2}}.

parameters.name: DistributedAuthenticationControl
parameters.description: Indicates support for Distributed Authentication Control (DAC) {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 11.3.9.3}}.

parameters.name: MaxMPDULen
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum MAC Protocol Data Unit (MPDU) length in octets. {{enum}}

parameters.name: NonTIMMode
parameters.description: Indicates support of non-Traffic Indication Map (non-TIM) operation {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 10.48}}.

parameters.name: DynamicAID
parameters.description: Indicates support of Dynamic Association ID (AID) operation {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 10.20}}.

parameters.name: GroupAID
parameters.description: Indicates support of Group Association ID (AID) {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 10.55}}.

parameters.name: BATSupport
parameters.description: Indicates support for the use of the Block Acknowledgment TWT (BAT) frame in Block Agreements {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 9.8.4.3}}.

parameters.name: RAWOperation
parameters.description: Indicates support for Restricted access window (RAW) operation {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 10.23.5}}.

parameters.name: PageSlicing
parameters.description: Indicates support for Page Slicing Operation {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 10.51}}.

parameters.name: PV1Frame
parameters.description: Indicates support for Protocol Version 1 (PV1) frames {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 9.8}}.

parameters.name: TxMCSNSS
parameters.description: Supported Tx S1G-MCS Map subfield and Coding Scheme (S1G-MCS) and Number of Spatial Streams (NSS) Set field as defined in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Figure 9-694}}.

parameters.name: RxMCSNSS
parameters.description: Supported Rx S1G-MCS Map subfield and Coding Scheme (S1G-MCS) and Number of Spatial Streams (NSS) Set field as defined in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Figure 9-694}}.

parameters.name: SUBeamformer
parameters.description: Indicates support for Single-User (SU) Beamformer {{bibref|802.11-2020|10.36.5 VHT sounding protocol}}.

parameters.name: SUBeamformee
parameters.description: Indicates support for Single-User (SU) Beamformee {{bibref|802.11-2020|10.36.5 VHT sounding protocol}}.

parameters.name: MUBeamformer
parameters.description: Indicates support for Multi-User (MU) Beamformer {{bibref|802.11-2020|10.36.5 VHT sounding protocol}}.

parameters.name: MUBeamformee
parameters.description: Indicates support for Multi-User (MU) Beamformee {{bibref|802.11-2020|10.36.5 VHT sounding protocol}}.

parameters.name: TravelingPilot
parameters.description: Indicates support for or the reception of PPDUs with traveling pilots {{bibref|802.11-2020|10.56 Traveling pilot operation}}.

parameters.name: TWTGrouping
parameters.description: Indicates support for Target Wake Time (TWT) Grouping {{bibref|802.11-2020|10.47.5 TWT grouping}}.

parameters.name: TWTRequestor
parameters.description: Indicates support for Target Wake Time (TWT) Requestor {{bibref|802.11-2020|10.47 Target wake time (TWT)}}.

parameters.name: TWTResponder
parameters.description: Indicates support for Target Wake Time (TWT) TWTResponder {{bibref|802.11-2020|10.47 Target wake time (TWT)}}.

parameters.name: AcceptSensorDevices
parameters.description: Indicates if this Wi-Fi HaLow radio accepts sensor associated devices (STAs).

parameters.name: AcceptNonSensorDevices
parameters.description: Indicates if this Wi-Fi HaLow radio accepts non-sensor associated devices (STAs).

object.description: This object describes the capabilities of the Wi-Fi HaLow radio, most of which can be extracted from the Sub 1 GHz (S1G) capabilities Information Element (IE) in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 9.4.2.200.2}}.
